_readme: TXR-1406 Seller's Disclosure Notice -- DocuSeal-ready widget list for the disclosure content grid + seller signing widgets. Coordinates are absolute PDF points (612x792, bottom-left origin, matching pdf-lib convention) measured against api/_assets/txr-1406-sellers-disclosure-base64.js via pdftotext -bbox on the rendered page, per the acroform-field-names-lie method -- never guessed from AcroForm field names (this PDF has none; it is a flat/0-AcroForm-field form). role is a generic slot token ("Seller 1"/"Seller 2") resolved to a real signer at send time by scripts/build-txr-1406-packet.js -- NOT a specific person's name, so this map is reusable across deals. Built 2026-09-29 fixing two defects found on the completed test PDF: (1) missing per-page seller initials -- OLD generator (gen-fields.py, 2026-09-25) placed them a full row above the real "Seller:" footer line; SELLER_LINE below is the verified real line position. (2) property address never appearing on pages 2-7 -- NOT a DocuSeal field at all; fixed separately by baking real PDF text via api/_assets/field-maps/txr-1406-address-coords.json before the PDF reaches DocuSeal. Also carries two pre-existing cosmetic fixes verified the same session: Section 11 report-count field no longer overlaps the printed word "attached:"; page 6 seller signature/date/printed-name boxes no longer overlap their own captions.
